headline: TRITN and EMC dominate unusual trading after sharp gaps and intraday surges, while PF and M-PAT led downside moves.
market_take: Coverage was broadly volatile, with 59 unusual-trading alerts, including 20 high-priority items. TRITN rose +50.0% over five days after a -33.33% open gap, while EMC opened with a -50.00% gap and rose +100.00% intraday. Property names were mixed, and SCGD combined a +5.45% daily move with volume at 10.11× alongside several recent filings.

sector_notes.note: PEACE gained +8.33% on a +8.33% open gap, while ROJNA fell -4.20% with volume at 4.44× and a 6.5σ volume-spike alert. ANAN rose +6.06% on volume at 7.61×, and PRECHA fell -7.41% after a capital-change filing.
SCGD rose +5.45% on volume at 10.11× and filed unreviewed Q3/2026 financial statements plus a share-repurchase resolution. DCON fell -6.25%, though volume was only 0.12×.

AQUA rose +10.00% on an intraday-move alert, while NRF gained +4.76% after a +9.52% open gap. CHOTI, M, SST, and SNP also triggered volume-spike alerts, and TU and ITC made acquisition-related filings.

TRITN posted a -33.33% open gap and +50.00% intraday move, while EMC recorded a -50.00% open gap and +100.00% intraday move. TPOLY and JCK also showed notable price action, with JCK up +5.56% and +18.8% over five days.
PF fell -20.00% and M-PAT fell -12.50%, the largest daily declines in the digest. AXTRART triggered a 5.2σ volume-spike alert, and TPRIME fell -4.40%.
